tech_support.label: Fake tech support
tech_support.why: Real security warnings never ask you to call a phone number or let a stranger control your computer.

gift_card.label: Gift card payment
gift_card.why: No real company, bank or government office takes payment in gift cards.

isolation.label: Asks for secrecy
isolation.why: Scammers ask you to keep quiet so nobody you trust can warn you.

delivery.label: Parcel fee
delivery.why: Couriers do not ask for small fees by text message or pop-up.

prize.label: Prize claim
prize.why: If you have to pay or share details to get a prize, it is not a prize.

government.label: Government threat
government.why: Government offices send letters. They do not threaten arrest by phone or web page.

account.label: Account threat
account.why: Banks and shops do not lock your account and then ask you to log in through a link.

investment.label: Too-good investment
investment.why: Nobody can promise guaranteed profits. Promises like this are a common way to steal savings.

payment_method.label: Unusual payment
payment_method.why: Requests to pay with crypto, wire transfers or cash machines are hard to reverse. Scammers like them for that reason.

refund.label: Overpayment refund
refund.why: The 'we refunded too much, please send it back' story is a trick. The first payment is never real.

urgency.label: Pressure to act now
urgency.why: Scammers set short deadlines so you act before you can think or ask someone.

safe_account.label: "Safe account" story
safe_account.why: Your bank will never ask you to move your money to keep it safe. Anyone who does is stealing it.

family_emergency.label: Family emergency
family_emergency.why: Scammers pretend to be a relative in trouble. Hang up and call that person on the number you already have.

subscription.label: Fake renewal charge
subscription.why: Fake invoices want you to call them. The number reaches the scammer, not the company.

recovery.label: Money recovery offer
recovery.why: People who lost money get offers to win it back for a fee. Those offers are a second scam.

qr_payment.label: QR code trick
qr_payment.why: You never need to scan a code to receive money. Scanning can send your money away or open a fake page.

utility.label: Utility cut-off threat
utility.why: Power, gas and water companies send written notices first. They do not demand instant payment to stop a cut-off.
